name: Wolf
spark: The mote keeps low and circles your heels; when you run, it is already ahead.

hybrid.text: It runs down what it wants and does not let go.

settled.name: Wolf pup
settled.text: All paws and ears. It follows you everywhere and has not yet learned it is not the same size as what it barks at.

paths.name: Courser
paths.text: It learned from you that the fight is won by getting there first.

prongs.name: Pack-runner
prongs.text: It runs where the party runs and is never the one out of place.

finishes.name: Pack-mother
finishes.text: The others' genii fall in behind it. Nobody told them to.

finishes.name: Line-runner
finishes.text: It has run every mile of the line you have, and knows the next post before you see its lamp.

prongs.name: Throat-taker
prongs.text: It waits for your Pattern the way a dog waits for a thrown stick.

finishes.name: Red Maw
finishes.text: When you are hurt it stops being careful.

finishes.name: Quiet Tooth
finishes.text: You do not hear it go. You hear what it went for.

prongs.name: Long-strider
prongs.text: It ranges out to where your shots land and holds what you hit until you come.

finishes.name: Name-hunter
finishes.text: It remembers every named beast that got away, and so does its nose.

finishes.name: Far Courser
finishes.text: A grey line at the edge of your sight that is always where the foe is about to be.

paths.name: Warder
paths.text: It learned from you that somebody has to stand in the door.

prongs.name: Hearth-wolf
prongs.text: It counts the party at every door and will not go through until the number is right.

finishes.name: Den-keeper
finishes.text: Where it lies down is the safest place in the zone, and the party knows it.

finishes.name: Shade-friend
finishes.text: The shades at the hearth speak to it before they speak to you.

prongs.name: Grey Shield
prongs.text: It takes the blow you did not see, and then the one you did.

finishes.name: Wall-wolf
finishes.text: It does not move back. Things that hit it learn something about walls.

finishes.name: Scar-bearer
finishes.text: Every blow you took is on its coat as well. It wears them forward.

prongs.name: Night-watch
prongs.text: It sleeps in the day now, because you do not sleep at night.

finishes.name: Post-wolf
finishes.text: A post it has lain beside stays lit a little longer than it should.

finishes.name: Lamp-eyed Wolf
finishes.text: Its eyes show you what is winding up in the dark before the dark does.

paths.name: Howler
paths.text: It learned from you that a voice carries further than teeth.

prongs.name: Caller
prongs.text: What it howls at turns to look, and for that moment is not looking at you.

finishes.name: Voice of the Pack
finishes.text: One howl, and every genius in earshot answers.

finishes.name: Oath-wolf
finishes.text: It was there when you swore, and it holds you to it harder than the Terms do.

prongs.name: Moon-reader
prongs.text: It lifts its head a breath before the strike comes. Watch its ears, not the foe.

finishes.name: Omen-wolf
finishes.text: It howls once on the morning of a bad day. It has not been wrong.

finishes.name: Still Wolf
finishes.text: It can sit so quiet beside you that the field itself goes quiet round it.

prongs.name: Storm-coat
prongs.text: Your element has got into its fur, and it shakes it off over whatever you point at.

finishes.name: Frost-ruff
finishes.text: Where it has run, the ground remembers winter.

finishes.name: Ember-ruff
finishes.text: Its ruff is banked coals. It lies down at the hearth and the hearth burns higher.
